title: Design-from-Image Workflow Manifest
description: Top-level workflow metadata + per-stage status. Spec source: docs/Design/_meta/IMAGE_TO_SPEC_WORKFLOW.md. Pilots may use legacy variant (1st) or current variant (2nd/3rd) — schema is permissive-required-core with `additionalProperties: true` (variant-specific fields tolerated).

$schema_version.description: Schema version (e.g., '1.0', '1.1'). Spec recommended; missing in 3rd pilot — flagged as DRIFT by validate_design_schemas.py.

$variant.description: Optional variant marker. Legacy 1st-pilot uses 'legacy'; current pilots omit.

image_inputs.description: Legacy 1st-pilot variant. Current variant uses input.image_paths.

pilot_metadata.description: Current variant: pilot_index / pilot_purpose / issue_ref / dataset etc.

stages.description: Per-stage status objects. Variant-tolerant: 1st adds bbox_refinement/stage2_ab_test; 2nd adds ab_test/ab_test_baseline; 3rd adds ab_test_baseline.

status.description: Stage status. Schema is permissive (no enum) since pilots use varied conventions — observed values: pending, not_started, in_progress, in_review, completed, interrupted, skipped, final, done, blocked, failed.
